ai_summary: Balmer Lawrie & Co. Ltd. delivered a robust financial performance in FY 2025-26, achieving 8.03% growth in Net Turnover and a 5.4% increase in Profit Before Tax, driven by strategic pivots towards domestic demand and exceptional contributions from its Logistics and Travel & Vacations businesses. While the company successfully navigated global volatility and strengthened its diversified operations, the Greases & Lubricants SBU faced profitability pressure due to intense market competition and raw material scarcity, marking a minor operational challenge amidst overall positive results.
